mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_buy_market_better.group_team(activity_id, group_team_id, leader_user_id, sku_id, required_num, current_num, settled_trade_num, team_status, team_create_time, team_expire_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{activityId}, #{groupTeamId}, #{leaderUserId}, #{skuId}, #{requiredNum}, #{currentNum}, #{settledTradeNum}, #{teamStatus}, #{teamCreateTime}, #{teamExpireTime}, now(), now())
mapper.select: SELECT activity_id, group_team_id, leader_user_id, sku_id, required_num, current_num, settled_trade_num, team_status, team_create_time, team_expire_time, team_end_time, create_time, update_time FROM group_buy_market_better.group_team WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND group_team_id = #{groupTeamId}

SELECT activity_id, group_team_id, leader_user_id, sku_id, required_num, current_num, settled_trade_num, team_status, team_create_time, team_expire_time, team_end_time FROM group_buy_market_better.group_team WHERE team_expire_time <= now() AND team_status = 0
